highlights.reason_zh: 公开数据、代码与探针权重让 agent 欺骗检测第一次具备低成本复测入口。
highlights.reason_en: Public data, code and probe weights make agent-deception detection practical to replicate.

highlights.reason_zh: 一个 5B 模型统一解析文档、图表、音频和视频，直接影响多模态摄取架构。
highlights.reason_en: One 5B model parses documents, charts, audio and video, directly affecting multimodal ingestion architecture.

highlights.reason_zh: Ai2 的 30 天生产数据给 GPU 公平调度提供了可量化的工程基线。
highlights.reason_en: Ai2 production data provides a measurable engineering baseline for fair GPU scheduling.

highlights.reason_zh: Claude Code 把更多 hook 与 gateway 故障改成默认拒绝，直接影响策略闸门。
highlights.reason_en: Claude Code makes more hook and gateway failures fail closed, directly affecting policy gates.

highlights.reason_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast 全量开放，使延迟敏感路由从预览变成生产选项。
highlights.reason_en: General availability of GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast turns low-latency routing into a production option.

coverage_zh: 36 个固定入口全部抓取并读完；本轮新增 6 条事件，更新 3 条既有事件，并完成 GitHub Copilot 30 日复核。召回自检匹配 16 条、此前已处置 5 条，并逐条处置 8 条未匹配线索：3 条 duplicate、3 条 filtered、2 条 out-of-scope。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and read. The run added six events, updated three existing events and completed the 30-day GitHub Copilot review. Recall audit matched 16 signals, recognized five previously handled signals and dispositioned eight unmatched items: three duplicate, three filtered and two out of scope.
